title: Complete full-parameter rerun launched on 26 October 2026

data.title: Complete full-parameter rerun launched on 26 October 2026
paragraphs: The user requested an entire rerun to seek incremental transcription improvement. One separately frozen trajectory starts from the same pinned pretrained base and trains all 55,151,433 parameters. The unchanged initial final model remains the default. This is an experiment, not evidence that full tuning improves accuracy.

All 2,052,751 qualified training views are retained: 220,174 distinct source utterances. Three passes schedule 6,158,253 view visits and 884,220 optimizer updates. Common Voice/AMI/CHiME-6/VOiCES objective weights remain 40.0807412535%/31.3596765027%/18.5595822438%/10%. Source balance and reduced quiet-view confidence are preserved. Development and evaluation groups remain excluded, verified against the full training pool.

Peak learning rate is 1e-5 with 1,000-update warmup and full-horizon cosine decay to 5e-7. Every row is visited once per pass. Native checkpoint scoring is fixed at 147370, 294740, 442110, 589480, 736850 and 884220 updates. Unlike the earlier short pilots, guard failures do not terminate this fresh-base run early; all three passes remain scheduled unless a user pause, numerical failure or exhausted recovery intervenes. There is no refit, extra trial or automatic promotion.

The previous full-method pilot had processed only 69,791 views at 10,000 updates and its comparison was inconclusive. This longer rerun tests substantially more exposure but changes both method and qualified-view coverage relative to the initial run, so it cannot isolate either cause. The short warm-start continuation also failed retention guards; none of its candidate weights are used here.

Selection screens equal-weight nine-cohort native WER improvement of at least 0.2 percentage points with clean/noisy/age/VOiCES/quiet and silence/noise retention limits. Paired cluster-bootstrap uncertainty accompanies the six checkpoint results. One candidate is frozen before exploratory confirmation; confirmation never chooses a runner-up. These are reused populations, with sparse VOiCES coverage and one-reader HiFiTTS clean confirmation. Its interval and the complete nine-cohort confirmation interval are undefined. Development intervals are not corrected for selecting among six checkpoints. No fresh independent confirmation, product-microphone validation or independent final age test is available.

Preparation and six meaningful automated tests passed. The owned worker has launched, verified exact pretrained initialization and saved its full optimizer state at step zero. GPU optimizer serialization and every batch shape are checked before actual training. There are no new accuracy results at launch. The Windows recovery monitor, existing heartbeat and CPU findings report are active for this new root. Prior models and completed policies remain preserved.

License provenance remains the original base/runtime Apache-2.0, Common Voice CC0, AMI and VOiCES CC-BY-4.0, and CHiME-6 CC-BY-SA-4.0 (resolved by the user on 23 October). Preserve attribution and applicable terms. The document retains the previously recorded unavailable-renderer limitation; this update is not a visual layout review.
